# Conflicts and Complications Following in the Wake of Bayl

*Page PDF 16*

## **Conflicts and Complications Following in the Wake of Bayl**
## Guidance
Clan Moulder believe that they have an asset in Bayl’s warband. Their plan is to inculcate a rivalry between the followers of Nurgle, and Clan Pestilens. By doing this they hope to sap the strength of two of their rivals, for the strength of the Sarl inhibits activity around Clan Moulder’s lair of Hell Pit, and the strength of Clan Pestilens rivals their own in the brutal politics of Skavendom. If agents of Clan Moulder can guide Bayl’s Warband to Clan Pestilens’ stronghold in the Southlands, revealing its existence to the followers of Nurgle, then they hope this will be enough to instigate such a conflict — all they need to do is ensure Bayl reaches his destination, and that some of the warband survive their encounter with Clan Pestilens and make it home. 

This is a tall order, but Clan Moulder have been able to exploit Bayl’s peculiar mutation, whispering prophecies and leaving portentous signs where only his eye-flies can find them. They also rendezvous with their inside man, Tannpína. Every third night he finds a reason to reconnoitre ahead alone, where a Skaven scout gives him detailed information on the journey ahead. 

His pathfinding advice has thus been remarkably astute and his standing in the warband has grown accordingly. The task is a lonely and exacting job for the Skaven scout, who must operate far from Hell Pit and may not rely on his fellow Skaven for fear of leaving clues that might one day cause Clan Pestilens to realise what really sent Bayl’s warband on their quest. 

## Dance of the Eye Flies

- Bayl is not a Chaos Sorcerer, but he has some understanding of the beliefs of the Norse Vitki who glean the lore of Nurgle. They can interpret their god’s messages in the movements of vermin such as flies and molluscs. Bayl has a degree of knowledge about such prophetic practice, but he is far from an expert in these matters. 

Bayl has scried signs of danger in the movement of his flies. Unfortunately, the details of the danger he faces remain unclear. He thinks he may be drawing the attention of enemies, or that a rival for the leadership of the tribe might arise from the ranks of his men — but this is a mistranslation of messages sent to warn him that he is on a foolish quest, and that one of his men is providing him with misleading advice. 

## Nurgle’s Gifts

- On the journey south, Bayl is not particularly focused on spreading disease during his travels, but contagion is bound to break out. A new strain of the Itching Pox seems to be taking hold in the lands through which Bayl passes. Physicians and Shallyan institutions may come to suspect that a vector travelling south from the Troll Country is to blame, and they may seek investigators to get to the root of the issue. 

## Skrolk Abroad

- Clan Moulder hope that Bayl and Skrolk will be bound to encounter one another because of their mischief and come to blows as a result. However, Skrolk has recently returned to his old lair of Quetza, deep in the jungle interior of Lustria. Clan Moulder are not aware the misleading quest they set Bayl upon is a wild goose chase. If they realise, they might try to direct Bayl towards another Southlands lair of Clan Pestilens or go further and try to persuade him to take an even longer trip over the Great Ocean towards Lustria.
